limits: Six interpretation calls maximum per run, no automatic retry or fallback. One corrected recheck only after a reproduced gap; task total at most 12 calls/$0.12 reserved.
One fresh session with 16 mock metadata posts; all six submitted turns use the model in live mode.
Previewizer browser rendering is replaced with one generated JPEG explicitly confirmed through existing export routes; the model receives no image.
Creator and extension authentication are synthetic callbacks; manual handoff packages/bytes are inspected without a browser or extension execution.
Schedules and variants remain ephemeral mock adapter records, not durable Rail entries. No production DB, platform request, publication or front-end testing.
This fixed journey is bounded acceptance evidence, not a broad language-quality benchmark.
